reviews.author: Rupa Prasad
reviews.text:
I wish I could give 0 stars to the authorities of this mall.
A week ago, we visited the mall with my mother, who is an Alzheimer’s patient. At some point, we realised that she was missing, and we immediately approached the mall management and security team for help.
What is extremely concerning is that my mother had apparently left the mall around 6:00 PM, but we were informed about this only around 8:00 PM. Those two hours were extremely critical, considering her medical condition and the fact that she is a vulnerable elderly person.

reviews.author: Dr Bijay Kumar Sahu
reviews.text: An excellent mall in the heart of city with stalls of many renowned international brands with a very good food court.

reviews.author: Shrikant Jadhav
reviews.text: This one star is for the mall and its poor management. The parking is like an adventure ride, on top of that they charge Rs 100 premium fees for poor service. Will not recommend visiting this place

reviews.author: Darrshana Mandlikk
reviews.text: It's one of the most visited mall in Pune. It's one of the oldest also. N number of brands are there here. It's a vast one n very big. Even visited IKEA here.

reviews.author: M V R
reviews.text: Wow.. This is the Mall of Pune. Almost all the brands are here.. One stop destination for all. PVR is not as good as KOPA mall. But it’s adequate.

reviews.author: BIPIN KURADE
reviews.text: Good mixture of Branded and non Branded stores
